data.games_lines: nflverse schedules (games.csv) - includes spread_line, moneylines, rest days, coaches, QBs. Book lines used as BENCHMARK ONLY, never model inputs.
data.team_stats: nflverse stats_player weekly 2010-2025 aggregated to team-game
data.talent: returning/incoming production shares from stats_player player-seasons

moneyline_test.reading: LOSS vs closing moneyline on all three metrics

learner_selection: Ridge alpha=10 beat HistGradientBoosting on validation (10.564 vs 10.766); ridge shipped.
gate_verdict: descriptive_failed_close - beats Elo with a settled interval, loses to the closing market with a settled interval on both spread and moneyline. Same shape as the CFB gates. NOT shipped as picks; measurement only.
known_gaps: OC/DC features not yet in (nflverse has head coach only; coordinators need PFR staff pages)
injury points are raw report counts, not snap/starter-weighted
no weather/turf features yet (games.csv has temp/wind/roof/surface unused)

iteration_2.changes: Garrett-approved 9/14: snap-weighted injury impact (starter snap share x report status), weather/turf (dome, wind, cold, wind x pass-form), week-18 resting-starters handling (dropping wk18 from train tested). OC/DC coordinator changes still in data acquisition (see README).
iteration_2.selection: validation 2023: v3.2b full val MAE 10.556 (best); wk18-drop variant val 10.558. Snap-injuries alone val 10.556/test 10.242; weather alone val 10.571/test 10.255; wind-interaction val 10.560/test 10.265; iter1 repro val 10.564/test 10.263.
iteration_2.verdict: descriptive_failed_close. Snap-weighted injuries are a small real gain (test 10.239 vs 10.263, best val) but do not close the gap to the market. Weather/turf and week-18 handling neutral. Model beats Elo with a settled interval; loses to the closing spread and closing moneyline with settled intervals.

iteration_3.changes: OC/DC change flags (offensive + defensive coordinator identity vs prior season, per team) added to v3.2b. Coordinator table: coordinators_2006_2025.csv (PFR-derived dataset 2006-2021; Wikipedia team-season staff sections 2022-2025; 20 structural Wikipedia gaps patched from pro-football-reference team pages; GB 2025 DC web-verified). Null coordinator = team listed no official coordinator (e.g. BUF 2023 DC, NE 2022 OC/DC).
iteration_3.selection: validation 2023: v3.2c full val MAE 10.534 (best), +OC only 10.541, +DC only 10.548, v3.2b 10.556.

v32c_minus_v32b_mae.reading: not an improvement; mean slightly favors v3.2b

iteration_3.verdict: NOT ADOPTED. Val selection preferred the OC/DC flags but the locked test did not confirm (10.254 vs 10.239) and val/test ordering disagree - the 9/6 rule blocks adoption. descriptive_failed_close stands; v3.2b remains the reference model. OC/DC change flags recorded as an honest negative.

iteration_4.changes: Garrett-approved 9/14, two levers. (a) Play-level EPA efficiency features from nflverse pbp 2010-2025 (team-game offensive/defensive EPA per play, success rate, pass/rush EPA splits; same prior+rolling-4 gp-weighted construction as v3.2). (b) PFF+ participation/grading data from Garrett's own account.

epa_lever.variants_tested: 8 (EPA off/def added to v3.2b; full 6-feature EPA block; EPA-only + context; pass/rush-yards dropped + EPA; EPA off/def only; EPA+splits; points+EPA)
epa_lever.selection: validation 2023: ALL variants lose to v3.2b (val 10.610-10.687 vs v3.2b 10.556). EPA is strongly collinear with the existing yards/points block; in-sample val prefers the incumbent.
epa_lever.note: EPA-only+context posted the best locked-test MAE of any variant tested to date (10.159, ATS 52.3%) but fails the val-first selection rule, so it is recorded, not adopted.
epa_lever.verdict: NOT ADOPTED - honest negative under the 9/6 rule.

pff_lever.access: Vault login to pff.com worked. premium.pff.com API verified on his PFF+ tier: every differentiating field is server-side restricted - grades_* (13 team fields), EPA, big-time throws, turnover-worthy plays, generated pressures, dropbacks, passing snaps, pressure-to-sack rate. Unlocked fields are standard box-score counting stats (attempts, completions, yards, TD, INT, sacks, first downs, qb_rating, ypa) which nflverse stats_player already provides with full history.
pff_lever.verdict: NO DATA TO TEST on his current tier - the unique PFF fields are paywalled above his subscription. Blocked by tier, not by auth. If he ever upgrades his PFF subscription, grades/pressure features can be pulled and gated the same way.

iteration_4.standing: v3.2b remains the reference model. descriptive_failed_close.

iteration_5.changes: Standing free-material direction: richer nflverse play-by-play aggregation. Tested situation-neutral EPA/success; early- and third-down splits; line decomposition (rush efficiency, sacks, QB hits, stuffs); skill decomposition (pass efficiency, CPOE, air/YAC EPA); explosive-play and red-zone splits. All features are pregame shifted rolling-4 blended with prior season; book lines remain benchmark-only.
iteration_5.selection: Validation 2023: every rich-PBP variant loses to v3.2b. Best new variant was line decomposition at 10.576 MAE vs v3.2b 10.556. Range 10.576-10.914; no candidate reaches the locked-test gate. Locked test was read only for the complete milestone record: new variants 10.246-10.402 vs v3.2b 10.239 and market 9.804.
iteration_5.verdict: NOT ADOPTED. No new variant beats the reference on validation, so bootstrap promotion testing is inapplicable. v3.2b remains the reference; descriptive_failed_close stands.
